thread:
alex: Heads-up: HarborLeaf (private) migration to dedicated-eu-central planned tonight 03:15 UTC. Proposed canary flow: 2% -> 20% -> 100% with 10m holds between steps. Need KMS window and final signoff.
priya: KMS rotates at 02:50-03:05 for that tenant. If we want a 30m buffer, start no earlier than 03:35.
diego: From infra: prefer 03:45 to avoid overlap with other backfills. Also confirm runtime pin and model sha.
alex: OK shifting to 03:45. Runtime pinned to runsvc v3.4.0 and model harborleaf-v2.0.0 (sha: a1b2c3d). Fallback: harborleaf-v1.9.8-compat.
mel: Release notes: https://redwood-internal/release/harborleaf/2.0.0 6 includes safety net for prefix cache eviction. QA ran quick perf tests, looked fine.
priya: Preflight checklist: secrets accessible, kms OK at 03:20, canary slice reserved, priming job ready. Ops confirms no other tenant windows.
deploybot: /deploy start --tenant harborleaf --cluster dedicated-eu-central --canary 2% --steps 3 --runtime runsvc:v3.4.0 --model a1b2c3d

alex: Rollback triggers (explicit): >0.8% 5xx sustained for 4m OR 95th latency > 400ms for 3m OR token cost increase >25% for 15m. Manual pause if any customer-facing errors are observed.
diego: Add an automated hold if memory OOMs occur on any node during canary. We'll run mem alerts at 80% and 90%.
mel: We should also run a smoke hitting both chat and embeddings after priming (5 each). Script below:
```
./scripts/smoke.sh harborleaf --concurrency 5 --count 5
```
priya: Acks: infra +1 (03:45 start).
alex: prod/eng ack from me. mel ack for QA.
deploybot: Canary job queued (job id: hb-5529991234-canary-01). Dashboards: https://grafana/internal/d/harborleaf-canary
ops-bot: Pager duty list: diego, alex. On-call SRE will escalate to infra lead after 8m of critical alerts.
alex: Note: we'll announce a 20m quiet window to HarborLeaf ops and post release notes to their tenant slack after step 2 completes. Manual rollback command if needed:
```
deploybot rollback --job hb-5529991234-canary-01 --to model=harborleaf-v1.9.8-compat
```
mel: I'll watch logs and traces. If anything suspicious, I will tag root cause channel and ping SRE. :mag:
